# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Iteration cand_0003. Parent = champion cand_0001 (val 0.560). cand_0002 (0.520) was REJECTED and
fully reverted. I fanned out 3 read-only diagnosis subagents over this iteration's ./trajectories/
(all cand_0001 traces): (A) the two tasks cand_0002 fixed (50630, 58147); (B) the four tasks
cand_0002 broke (47741, 38332, CF_11072, 73-45) to learn what NOT to re-touch; (C) the remaining
coverage/logic failures to find any NEW safe win.

## Why cand_0002 regressed (root-caused from traces — do NOT re-try these)
- **73-45** (passing) writes bold-red **rich-text runs**, which openpyxl cannot emit, so it legitimately
  hand-edits the sheet XML. cand_0002's "do NOT hand-edit XML / repackage zip" rule broke it.
- **CF_11072** (passing) relies on a **boolean conditional-formatting FormulaRule** (`=$F11=MAX(...)`).
  cand_0002's "a formula that returns a logical TRUE/FALSE → compute a literal" clause broke it.
- **47741** (passing) — cand_0002's formula-block RESTRUCTURE ("prefer emitting the CORRECTED FORMULA
  over reimplementing") destabilised the `_xlfn.TEXTJOIN`→literal decision it depended on.
=> The lesson: this dense prompt regresses when the formula block is restructured or when a global
"literalize / no-XML" rule is broadened. I kept the formula block and XML guidance UNCHANGED.

## Ranked cluster list (this iteration)
| rank | cluster | tasks | root cause | tag | lever | prose-fixable? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | SPLIT/EXTRACT piece written as datetime, GT is text | 50630 | agent parsed a split-out date fragment into a real datetime (its own verify even enforced it); GT keeps the fragment as the original text string | KNOWLEDGE | worked example | YES |
| 2 | AutoFilter collapsed rows → coverage shortfall | 110-2 | agent deleted/collapsed non-matching rows; a filter HIDES rows but the scorer compares `.value`, so the full table must remain (coverage 9/39) | KNOWLEDGE | missing-rule | YES |
| 3 | over-strict "no cell outside range" verify → XML surgery / false positives | 58147, 38332 | naive check flags benign openpyxl re-serialization; drove 58147 into recalc-breaking XML surgery | CONFLICT | (SKIPPED — see below) | marginal |
| 4 | genuine logic / ambiguous-spec misreads | 450-9, 325-44, 51359, 5192, 56637, 59743, 57090, 59259, 57232, 30709, 56427, 3911, 39046, 53367, 11842 | agent interprets an under-specified / internally-inconsistent multi-step spec differently from the single GT interpretation | out of scope | none | NO (would need hardcoding) |
| 5 | text placeholder in a numeric range | 55931 | wrote "New" for unmatched rows; GT has ints | borderline | (SKIPPED — regression risk) | risky |
| — | infra | 58147, 56996 | grader flags 58147 "recalculation FAILED … Not a prompt defect — do not optimize against it"; 56996 sources RANDBETWEEN (non-deterministic) | ENVIRONMENT | none | NO |

## Changes made this iteration (both in prompt.md; task_template.md untouched)
| cluster | lever | file | edit | blast-radius class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 (50630) | worked example (menu #5) | prompt.md | Added a worked SPLIT/EXTRACT example under the type block: split pieces stay TEXT even when they look like dates / the instruction names the year; convert to a real datetime ONLY when the instruction says convert/parse/standardise. | BOUNDED — reinforces the existing verb-conditioned type rule; only affects SPLIT/EXTRACT tasks. |
| 2 (110-2) | missing-rule (menu #4, additive) | prompt.md | Added: a filter/AutoFilter HIDES rows, does not delete/collapse; on in-place filtering keep the full table's values (scorer compares `.value`); excludes copy-to-new-range tasks. | BOUNDED — new predicate, conditioned on "filter/AutoFilter in place"; no passing task is an in-place filter task. |

## Verify-the-fix (trace evidence → what the edit changes)
- **50630**: trace wrote `E5 = datetime.datetime(2021,11,15)` for a split-out due-date fragment; grader:
  "2 cell(s) hold datetime where str was expected." The agent treated the fragment as a CONVERT. The new
  worked example makes the SPLIT-stays-text case concrete ("including the ones that look like dates, EVEN IF
  the instruction mentions the date's year/format") → agent writes the string, matching GT. SAFE: 47741
  writes a computed text join (not a split), 73-45 preserves text (no conversion), 38332 writes ints,
  CF_11072 writes fills — none is a split-to-date task; 51958 (passing CONVERT task) still converts because
  the example is explicitly verb-conditioned.
- **110-2**: trace physically rebuilt the table keeping only the 2 matching rows → coverage 9/39,
  "Most of the target range was left unfilled." The new rule tells the agent a filter HIDES rows and the
  full table's values must remain → agent leaves all rows' values in place, filling the range. SAFE: rule
  fires only on filter/AutoFilter-in-place instructions; the 28 passing tasks are counts/formulas/CF/
  rich-text/splits — none filters in place, so none changes behavior. Explicitly excludes the
  copy-matches-to-a-new-range case so it cannot mislead an extract task.

## Deliberately SKIPPED (and why)
- **Cluster 3 (outside-range check softening)**: 58147's zero is grader-flagged INFRASTRUCTURE ("recalculation
  FAILED … do not optimize against it"); 38332 already passes. Softening would add words for ~zero scoreable
  gain, and touching the verify step risks the reader — cand_0002's lesson is that broad edits regress. Not worth it.
- **Cluster 5 (55931 text-sentinel ban)**: placeholder/label text is legitimately the right answer on some
  tasks → real regression risk; subagent flagged it. Dropped.
- **Cluster 4 (logic misreads)**: 6+ tasks are under-specified or internally-inconsistent specs (e.g. 5192's
  two worked examples contradict each other; 51359 passes the visible case and only differs on hidden edge
  cases). Not closable by a general rule without hardcoding the GT interpretation, which overfits and fails
  the held-out gate. Left alone.
- Re-adding ANY of cand_0002's regressors (no-XML ban, boolean→literal clause, formula-block restructure). Refuted.

## Good things to PRESERVE (unchanged this iteration)
- The "code is re-run on hidden inputs → compute, never hardcode" block (highest-value rule).
- The NARROW formula rule (ordinary + legacy-array formulas stay live; only spill/`_xlfn.`/volatile → literals);
  do NOT restructure it — 47741/38332/CF_11072 depend on its current shape.
- No blanket "don't hand-edit XML" and no "boolean formula → literal" rule — both regress passing tasks
  (73-45 rich-text via XML; CF_11072 boolean CF FormulaRule).
- The verify checklist (value+type, coverage count, in-range).

## Process & features used
- 3 parallel `general-purpose` diagnosis subagents (fix-targets / regression-safety / new-win scan), read-only.
  Edits authored serially into this one candidate (2 small non-conflicting edits; no worktrees needed).
- Confirmed the two salvage/new fixes against actual trace evidence; did not run evaluation.
